dialogues.speaker: Ranjit
dialogues.text: I'm all set. Or would you like to chat instead?

choices.text: By the way, how exactly are we going to eat the Pyro Regisvine fruit?

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Well, we're out in the wild, so simple works best. First, we'll need to trim the fruit's shape without getting burned.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Next, we cut off a small piece, dig a groove into the middle of the fruit, then put in a couple chunks of butter, Whopperflower Nectar, and your preferred spices. Then we roast — all done.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: I'd say that Pyro Regisvine's fruit has a more striking flavor than that of apples. Really sears itself into your memories...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Oh, the little ones are awfully cute! What with their big round eyes and roly-poly bellies...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: As I said before, they're probably the first things you'll meet if you travel to Natlan through Sumeru. The mines in eastern Natlan are their stomping grounds.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Those mines are also home to the Nanat{RUBY#[D]Children of Echoes}zcayan people. Fine miners and excavators, they are, and skilled appraisers of gems.

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Sound boring to you, right? But they're a happy lot, especially their chief...

response.speaker: Ranjit
response.text: Whatever the case, be sure to pay them a visit if you find yourself heading to Natlan in the future... Those little Tepetlisauri, I mean. You'll love 'em, I can already tell.

choices.text: Can't think of much to say at the moment.
